explanation: A special case of the Erdős similarity problem: does every measurable A ⊆ ℝ of positive measure contain an affine copy {a·2^{−n} + b} (a ≠ 0) of {1, 1/2, 1/4, …}? The answer asserted is "no", tagged solved via a 2026 OpenAI Lean proof. The encoding is faithful (n ranges over ℕ, giving 1, 1/2, 1/4, …). The solved status rests on that recent external result, which I could not independently verify; this famous case was long open.
